scope: TG2 Qwen3-compatible Python runtime overlay only

observations.v5_result: The cached images entered Running promptly, verified the frozen bundle and inputs, then failed before step 0 because Transformers 4.53.2 interpreted the Qwen3-VL checkpoint as Qwen2.5-VL.
observations.root_cause: The repository Python environment provides Transformers 4.53.2, huggingface-hub 0.32.3, and tokenizers 0.21.1; that combination does not implement Qwen3-VL.
observations.validated_fix: A 113 MB overlay containing Transformers 5.2.0, huggingface-hub 1.7.1, and tokenizers 0.22.2 was validated against both the East working tree and the frozen North staging tree. Both produced Qwen3VLProcessor with a tokenizer and imported the frozen training entrypoint.

changes: Prepend the versioned runtime overlay to PYTHONPATH before invoking the unchanged frozen TG2 runner.
Verify three package identity hashes and exact package versions in every task entrypoint.
Fail fast unless AutoProcessor resolves the frozen checkpoint to Qwen3VLProcessor with a tokenizer.
Tag scheduler attempts with runtime revision v6 so failures from earlier runtime revisions cannot consume the v6 retry budget.
invariants: All frozen admission manifests, formal runners, model code, data, checkpoints, arms, seeds, optimizer settings, global batch, training steps, and result selection remain unchanged.
The overlay changes only package loading for three Hugging Face runtime packages and retains the existing Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.7.1, CUDA, Accelerate, Polars, and remaining environment.
TG1A and TG1B remain on runtime amendment v4 and are not rearmed by this amendment.
Every v5 failure occurred before optimizer step 0 and contributes no scientific result.
